title: Saturation factor one for even Spin groups
exact_target:
For $G=Spin(2n)$ over C, $n\geq 2$, and dominant integral weights $\lambda ,\mu ,
u $ whose sum belongs to the root lattice, does the existence of a G-invariant in $V(N\lambda )\otimes V(N\mu )\otimes V(N
u )$ for some integer $N\geq 1$ imply the existence of one in $V(\lambda )\otimes V(\mu )\otimes V(
u )$?
